svg.title: A metric is a claim about which errors you will trade
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “A metric is a claim about which errors you will trade” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Three loss shapes drawn over one error axis - a V for absolute error targeting the median, a parabola for squared error targeting the mean, and a tilted pinball V targeting the ninetieth percentile - with MAPE struck out beside them, two ranked lists of ten whose identical recall at five hides an MRR of 0.50 against 1.00, and a reliability diagram where a raw booster's curve sags well below the diagonal at ECE 0.1366 until Platt scaling pulls it back to 0.0188.
svg.text: A metric is a claim about which errors you will trade
draw it from memory, then compare
